E0929

Body-level `derive X;` is retired; request the derive with `#X` and reserve `derive` for provider definitions (D-ONCE-DERIVE1=A)

What

Body-level `derive X;` is retired; request the derive with `#X` and reserve `derive` for provider definitions (D-ONCE-DERIVE1=A)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0929

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0929: tests/ui/E0929_body_capability_derive.stderr.

Error [E0929]: `derive Comparable` inside a type body is retired
  --> tests/ui/E0929_body_capability_derive.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     derive Comparable
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: a derive request has one spelling: the marker before the type; `derive` defines providers
 Fix: write `#Comparable` before the type
